image_description: A person viewed from the back/side wearing a black academic gown with pink facings and a black doctoral tam (cap). The subject has brown hair tied back. The background is a solid light blue.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the mid-torso/chest level; the lower half of the garment and ankles are not visible.
The subject is angled away from the camera, showing the back and side profile. The center-front opening is occluded by the body's rotation.
The gown exhibits significant volume around the shoulders and arms, successfully hiding the underlying body shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The arms are positioned such that the hands and the distal ends of the sleeves are either out of frame or obscured by the angle.
The front of the gown is not visible due to the rear-side viewing angle.
The neckline is covered by the gown and hood/facing; no underlying shirt or collar is clearly distinguishable.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black fabric shows low specular highlights, consistent with a matte, heavy material like wool or polyester.
The texture appears uniform and smooth without glossy reflections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wrists and sleeve ends are not visible in the frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The hair texture appears slightly smudged and plastic-like where it meets the neck and cap, lacking distinct strand definition typical of high-fidelity renders.
The doctoral tam (cap) has a slightly irregular, soft geometry that doesn't fully conform to the rigid structure expected of a velvet tam, appearing slightly melted into the head shape.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of academic regalia (doctoral vs. bachelor/master) and confirm class alignment.
To check for edge bleeding between the black gown/pink facing and the blue background, and ensure the gown is a single connected component.
To assess the realism of the fabric folds and lighting consistency on the curved surfaces of the gown.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between gown and background
Anatomical plausibility of the shoulder/neck region under the gown
Structural integrity of the academic cap
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'pink' facing on the gown. In AI generations, colored facings often bleed into the black fabric or have inconsistent geometry. Verify if the pink panels follow the logical drape of the gown over the shoulders. Also, scrutinize the connection point between the cap and the hair/head for any fusion artifacts.
